briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward agentic AGI capabilities

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate multi-agent systems amid escalating compute investments. Regulatory scrutiny intensifies on export controls while safety gaps widen in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4 with native tool-use orchestration; Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-V3 claims 40% inference cost reduction. Meta open-sources Llama 4 400B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic workflows.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Nvidia Blackwell ramp hits 2M units monthly; Microsoft and xAI announce joint 100k H100 cluster in Texas. TSMC reports 3nm AI chip yields improving.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols become mandatory for BCI and autonomous vehicle deployments by 2028?
